COMMERCIAL TUNING LENS

If this were your system, these become targets

This page is still an internal modeled result, not a customer savings claim. The value of compressing the evidence is to show what a customer or investor should look at first, then what engineering would tighten next.

01

Raise the floor

Program 41 already avoided negative complete rounds. The next question is how to improve the weakest positive windows and reduce low-tail variability.

02

Interrogate the mixed control result

ABLATION still finished above RESET/PERSISTENT in aggregate on this run. That should remain visible and become a specific engineering question, not a buried footnote.

03

Validate on a customer lane

The commercial next step is a controlled shadow deployment with agreed measurement rules, so improvements are judged by comparable real-world operating data.
